volumeConstraint.description: Volume constraint on the design field.
volumeConstraint.$comment: sources/problem/constraints/volume_constraint.f90:134-143; the constraint needs a Brinkman design (:310).

limit.description: Limit on the design's volume fraction of the `mask_name` zone (of the whole domain when `mask_name` is empty), not an absolute volume: the constraint value is limit - volume / volume_domain (volume_constraint.f90:186-204,247-250). A minimum unless `is_max`. Required, a JSON real.

is_max.description: Treat `limit` as a maximum. Default false.

mask_name.description: Point zone the volume is measured on; empty for the whole domain. The zone also sets the volume the fraction is normalised by (volume_constraint.f90:186-204). Default empty.

mapping.description: Mapping cascade applied to the design before the volume is measured.
